note: v1_action: every irreversible class is denied; exception: harness:web-researcher GETs/queries under a per-job grant that pass the query guard.

external_message.examples: send email / SMS / chat, post to social media, publish

payee_change.examples: new or changed supplier bank details (Sheba/IBAN)

price_publish.examples: price change in a live shop

destructive.examples: delete files outside run state, rm -rf, drop table, delete a cloud resource, git push (any), write outside the workspace

external_write.examples: CRM / ERP writes, Sheets shared with others, deploy

automation_create.examples: scheduled job, routine, webhook or standing rule

egress_offlist.examples: network request to a domain not on the allowlist (any network from Bash in v1)

egress_with_data.examples: request carrying workspace data or business names (query strings, search queries, POST bodies)

unknown_mcp_write.examples: MCP tool not tagged read in the connector registry

self_written_exec.examples: running code the agent wrote this task (scripts, inline -c/-e code, code piped to a shell) outside harness-sandbox-exec

local_reversible.examples: files in run state or a git-tracked workspace

draft_create.examples: creating a draft with a connector-registry tool tagged draft

read.examples: read-only tool call (not in the spec table; never irreversible)

protected_path.examples: write to a protected path, read of keys/ or experience/, direct fold_ledger.py call (not in the spec table)

unknown.examples: anything the classifier cannot recognise or parse; unknown resolves to irreversible
